title: Flash message feedback for validation errors and status
description: The app uses Flask's flash() to display one-time feedback messages for validation errors (missing username, missing password, duplicate username, incorrect credentials, missing title) and the base template renders them via get_flashed_messages(). Messages appear only once per request cycle.
spec:
1. Verify flaskr/auth.py calls flash(error) for each validation path: 'Username is required.', 'Password is required.', 'User {username} is already registered.', 'Incorrect username.', 'Incorrect password.'.
2. Verify flaskr/blog.py calls flash(error) for 'Title is required.' on create and update.
3. Verify flaskr/templates/base.html renders flash messages via get_flashed_messages() in a .flash div.
4. Verify tests/test_auth.py and tests/test_blog.py assert on flash message content in response bodies.
